g.text: Worker working-effect criteria not met: mean +0.000; 3/6 positive members. No automatic rollout.
The +0.5 target applies only to the overall mean; the −0.5 harm bound applies to each member. At least four member means must be positive.
Six members are replication units; the 72 case pairs are within-member observations. No confidence intervals or significance claims are shown.
Sprocket uses six matched cases × three seeds. Counts are descriptive; 18 outputs are not 18 independent cases or evidence of worker-learning benefit.
